assumptions: `price_expectation: 1056` was emitted exactly as the card declares it, with the artefact's 1,016 printed beside it and matches_price_expectation:false, rather than substituting a number the card did not ask for.

The three refusal MODES are the card's floor/effective-n/undecidable-quality; the two extra STRUCTURAL refusals (absent usable_for, missing baseline) are additions the card's rules 4, 5 and test (g) require, and they stop the emission rather than becoming a verdict.

An all-refused run still EMITS the report (exit 0) with every cell named and refused, because a refusal is a first-class output; only 'no cell files at all' stops the emission (exit 2) and only a missing baseline exits 3.

`difference_sign` on each h2 per-arm row is sign(cached_inclusive - uncached) for THAT arm; the H2 limb signs (sign of C-A per limb) live in h2.comparison, where the both-limbs-neither-picked rule is applied by verify_tranche1.h2_compare, not by a local copy.

Grid identity is the four load-bearing provenance fields via same_provenance, so era A (tools_mode off) and era B (tools off -> on) can never merge; unknown-vs-unknown also refuses, which yields one grid per unknown-prov cell rather than a silent merge.
`--grade` was not supplied (no grade_v5 document exists for the grid), so H3 and TVS are refused by name rather than populated from synthetic or row-derived denominators.
